### What was implemented

[`origit/origit/mcp.py`](origit/origit/mcp.py) — full replacement of the stub:

- **`resolve(root, ref)`** — one `git rev-parse` subprocess call to expand any ref to a full SHA.
- **`handle(request, root)`** — JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatcher. Never raises. Handles: `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, notifications (no `id` → `None`), and unknown methods (`-32601`).
- **`serve(root)`** — stdin line loop: parse JSON, call `handle`, write response + `\n` to stdout, ignore malformed lines.
- **`_tool_taint`** — calls `notes.commits` → `taint.query`, then adds `session_labels` and per-commit `session_label` exactly as [`cli.taint`](origit/origit/cli.py:547) does.
- **`_tool_show`** — resolves commit, reads the note, returns `{sha, subject, verified, record}` (or `record: None` when missing; `isError: True` when resolve fails).
- **`_tool_log`** — calls `sessions.group`, slices to `limit`, strips the full `record` key from each run, returns `{repo, head, base, sessions}`.
